cohort: 113 women categorized as Robson Group 2 (nulliparous) or Robson Group 4 (multiparous) with a single, cephalic, term fetus who were induced, augmented, or underwent cesarean birth before labor
finding: While rates of primary cesarean birth were high in both Robson Groups 2 and 4, intrapartum cesareans were generally associated with appropriate risk factors and indications.
mod_finding: This study found that rates of cesarean birth among women who have a term, single, cephalic fetus and are induced, augmented, or undergo prelabor cesarean birth are high, with intrapartum cesareans seemingly associated with appropriate risk factors and indications.
